blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Some senator-judges shared on Monday their qualms about the relevance of tackling the firearms owned by Vice President Sara Duterte as the impeachment court continued examining her alleged unexplained wealth. The senator-judges questioned the importance of the House prosecution panel’s presentation of Police Major Joericson Sangalang of the Philippine National Police Firearms and Explosives Office (PNP-FEO). Upon presenting their witness, House prosecutor Rep. Ysabel Zamora offered Sangalang’s testimony to include, among others, that Duterte and her spouse, Manases Carpio, “maintain a hobby in gun collecting by owning… more than 50 firearms… with a value of at least P7 […]...
